comparison.objective: Brace a plate while pressing a sprung plate guard onto its rim.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, force-controlled clip installation, alignment, and release. It shares stabilization and spring-force management but no fine setting or verification cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Guard seated to specified depth; plate displacement must remain below 1.2 cm; full credit requires stable released objects and 10 cm gripper clearance. No separate spec is present.
comparison.reason: Tests installation against a clip spring while preventing workpiece slip, not calibration of a variable damper.
